description: A floor-length ivory Aserai gown with an opaque square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, edged with fine gold-and-brown geometric embroidery down the front, around the neckline, cuffs and hem. A decorated woven belt with a round clasp and hanging strap secures the waist. A brown-gold patterned wrap rests around the forearms, and gold embroidered flat shoes show below the skirt. Small gold earrings, a necklace and a bracelet provide restrained ornament. No headgear, veil, armor or weapons are present.
